Built-in NFC support means you never have to fumble for your card again, whether you are commuting or travelling. One-handed operation removes the card-pulling step entirely and saves you time at the counter.
Built-in N52-grade magnets lock the wallet onto any MagSafe-compatible device, so it will not slip or fall out of a pocket or bag. It holds 1 to 2 cards neatly in place for instant access.
A precision-engineered metal layer sits between the card compartment and the magnets and blocks magnetic interference. Your cards stay protected and fully functional day after day.
At only 38 grams this slim wallet feels almost weightless. Its ergonomic shape sits comfortably in the hand for a fatigue-free grip.
